normal.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a transparent 2D historical strategy-game unit sprite: the complete German 8.8 cm Pak 43/41 on its two-wheel SPLIT-TRAIL carriage in DEPLOYED FIRING POSITION. Perfect orthographic 90-degree overhead plan view, horizontal barrel pointing LEFT. Image 1 is the approved authoritative Pak 43/41 technical top view for proportions, component shapes and arrangement; its rear trails are shown folded for transport, so change ONLY their articulation: swing the two long rear trails apart into a clearly open V towards the RIGHT, roughly 25 degrees outward each side of the centerline. Preserve their actual length and slim box-beam construction, and include broad recoil spades at both separated ends. Leave large genuine transparent negative space BETWEEN the open trails. Image 2 is a museum photo for physical construction: preserve the two large solid rubber-rimmed wheels, transverse axle, low split carriage, angular sloping double gun shield, exposed central breech and gun-laying controls. The wheels are seen edge-on from overhead, as two long narrow tread rectangles above and below the axle; do NOT draw round wheel faces in top view. Image 3 is style only: simplified gray-green game painting, thick clean dark outlines, restrained flat highlights, high small-scale readability. Match image 1's very long slender L/71 stepped barrel, double-baffle muzzle brake, compact recoil cradle and narrow overhead footprint of the angular shield, NOT an oversized solid rectangular shield. No cruciform base, no four outriggers, no circular platform, no turret. No crew, ammunition piles, ground, shadows, text, emblems, smoke or perspective. Fit the entire deployed piece in a wide landscape canvas, keep all extremities unclipped with a modest transparent margin. Truly transparent background. This must read clearly as the approved B blueprint with the trails opened for firing.
